# Import and tidy up data
```{r import raw data}
# prolific batch 1 (n=30)
batch1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/00.exp1-raw-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)
batch1_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/01.exp1-attnchecks-batch1.csv")%>%mutate(batch=1)

# prolific batch 2 (n=30)
batch2 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/02.exp1-raw-batch2.csv")%>%mutate(batch=2)
batch2_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/03.exp1-attnchecks-batch2.csv")%>%mutate(batch=2)

# prolific batch 3 (n=76)
batch3 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/04.exp1-raw-batch3.csv")%>%mutate(batch=3)
batch3_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/05.exp1-attnchecks-batch3.csv")%>%mutate(batch=3)

# prolific batch 4 (n=35)
batch4 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/06.exp1-raw-batch4.csv")%>%mutate(batch=4)
batch4_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/07.exp1-attnchecks-batch4.csv")%>%mutate(batch=4)

# prolific batch 5 (n=3)
batch5 <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/08.exp1-raw-batch5.csv")%>%mutate(batch=5)
batch5_attnchecks <- read_csv("./data/exp-1/09.exp1-attnchecks-batch5.csv")%>%mutate(batch=5)

# bind all
data <- rbind(batch1, batch2, batch3, batch4, batch5)
attn_checks <- rbind(batch1_attnchecks, batch2_attnchecks, batch3_attnchecks, batch4_attnchecks, batch5_attnchecks)
```

```{r apply inclusion criteria}
# filter based on color question
L_filtered_id <- attn_checks %>%
  filter(attn_check_1_response=="yellow") %>%
  distinct(unique_id) # all participants answered this question correctly

# set up trial names, create and select relevant columns
L_data <- data%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% L_filtered_id$unique_id)%>%
  mutate(data_type="within subjects",
         manipulation_type = case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "1 agent,")==TRUE ~ "baseline",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "attention_checks")==TRUE ~ "attention_checks",
                                 TRUE ~ "main"),
         A_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "intentional")==TRUE ~ "intentional drop",
                                       str_detect(trial_condition, "no drop")==TRUE ~ "no drop-off",
                                       TRUE ~ "accidental drop"),
         B_intentionality=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "pickup")==TRUE ~ "intend to own",
                                         str_detect(trial_condition, "walkaway")==TRUE ~ "no intent to own",
                                       TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         B_knowledge=case_when(str_detect(trial_condition, "aware")==TRUE ~ "knowledgeable",
                                    str_detect(trial_condition, "ignorant")==TRUE ~ "ignorant",
                                    TRUE ~ "Not Applicable"),
         blue_agent_first=case_when(str_detect(agent_order, "A_2,A_1")==TRUE ~ FALSE,
                                       TRUE ~ TRUE))%>%
  select(unique_id,data_type,batch,trial_condition,manipulation_type,A_intentionality,B_intentionality,B_knowledge,
         blue_agent_first, A1_value, A2_value, object_cost_response,id)

# extract object cost judgments
L_data_object_cost <-L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="attention_checks")%>%
  select(unique_id, object_cost_response)

# add object cost judgments to ownership judgment data
L_data_long <- L_data%>%
  filter(manipulation_type!="attention_checks")%>%
  rename(A=A1_value, B = A2_value)%>%
  gather(agent, value, A,B)%>%
  select(-object_cost_response)%>%
  left_join(L_data_object_cost)%>%
  rename(object_cost = object_cost_response)

L_data_long$object_cost <- as.numeric(L_data_long$object_cost)
L_data_long$value <- as.numeric(L_data_long$value)
L_data_long$agent <- factor(L_data_long$agent, levels=c("A", "B"))

# filter out participants based on pre-registered exclusion criteria
baseline_data<- L_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline" & agent=="B")%>% 
  spread(agent,value)%>%
  spread(trial_condition,B)

baseline_wide <- baseline_data%>%
  group_by(unique_id)%>%
  summarise_all(function(x){x[!is.na(x)]})%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")

strict_baseline_filter_id <- baseline_wide%>%
  filter(`1 agent,accidental`==0 & `1 agent,intentional`==0 & `1 agent,no drop`==0)

strict_baseline_filtered_data_long <- L_data_long%>%
  filter(unique_id %in% strict_baseline_filter_id$unique_id)

# report inclusion rate
nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id)/nrow(L_filtered_id) # 69.3%
nrow(L_filtered_id) - nrow(strict_baseline_filter_id) # 53 participants excluded
```

# Summary statistics and tests for baseline and main trials
```{r prepare dataframe}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_intentionality,levels = c("Not Applicable", "no intent to own", "intend to own"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$A_intentionality,levels = c("no drop-off","accidental drop","intentional drop"))
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge <- factor(strict_baseline_filtered_data_long$B_knowledge,levels = c("Not Applicable", "knowledgeable","ignorant"))

Main_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="main")%>%
  spread(agent,value)

Baseline_conditions<-strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  spread(agent,value)
```

## Baseline trials
```{r summary statistics}
strict_baseline_filtered_data_long%>%
  filter(manipulation_type=="baseline")%>%
  group_by(A_intentionality,agent)%>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value),
            SD = sd(value))%>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r paired t-test for the original owner}
A_nodrop <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="no drop-off")%>%select(A)
A_accidental <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop")%>%select(A)
A_intentional <- Baseline_conditions%>%filter(A_intentionality=="intentional drop")%>%select(A)

t.test(A_nodrop$A, A_accidental$A, paired = TRUE)
t_to_d(10.834, df=119, paired = T)

t.test(A_accidental$A, A_intentional$A, paired = TRUE)
t_to_d(8.4968, df=119, paired = T)
```

## Main trials
### Trials where the original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership
```{r percentage and Fisher's exact test}
# percentage of judging one agent owns more than the other
Main_conditions%>%
  filter(A_intentionality=="accidental drop" & B_intentionality=="intend to own")%>%
  mutate(Difference_AB = A-B,
         What_difference = case_when(Difference_AB>0 ~ "A owns more",
                                 Difference_AB==0 ~ "equal",
                                 TRUE ~ "B owns more"))%>%
  group_by(trial_condition, What_difference)%>%
    summarise(count=n(),
              freq=count/120)

# Fisher's exact test
accidental_pickup <-data.frame(knowledgeable=c(71,49),
                               ignorant=c(55,65))

fisher.test(accidental_pickup)
```

# Voronoi partition
## set up the Voronoi space and function
See code in "Experiments 1, 2, 3, & 4 - Voronoi partition.Rmd"
```{r function}
get_Voronoi_freq_CIs <- function(which_df){
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- which_df%>%
    mutate(G1 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==1 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G2 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==2 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G3 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==3 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G4 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==4 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE),
           G5 = case_when(which_Voronoi_group==5 ~ TRUE,
                          TRUE ~ FALSE)
           )
  
  G1_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G1, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G1\nneither A or B owns")
  
  G2_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G2, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G2\nA owns, B doesn't")
  
  G3_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G3, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G3\nunsure")
  
  G4_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G4, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G4\nA doesn't, B owns")
  
  G5_CIs <- voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
    group_by(trial_condition)%>%
    tidyboot(G5, statistics_functions = c(ci_lower, mean, ci_upper), na.rm=TRUE)%>%
    rename(mean=empirical_mean, ci_lower=fn1, ci_upper=fn2)%>%
    mutate(which_Voronoi_group_text = "G5\nBoth A and B own")
  
  voronoi_freq_CIs <- rbind(G1_CIs, G2_CIs, G3_CIs, G4_CIs, G5_CIs)
  return(voronoi_freq_CIs)
}
```

```{r read in assigned Voronoi group for participants}

#write_csv(Baseline_conditions, "./data/exp-1/12.exp1-baseline-conditions.csv")

Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs <- get_Voronoi_freq_CIs(data_voronoi_baseline)
```

## binomial testing of intuition significance
```{r baseline trials with (SI) Table. 4}
# baseline trials
strict_baseline_voronoi_freq<- Baseline_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df <- strict_baseline_voronoi_freq%>% # provides information in SI Table. 4
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels=c("1 agent,intentional","1 agent,accidental","1 agent,no drop")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

baseline_trial_condition_no <- baseline_binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

baseline_binom_df_isTheory <- baseline_trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(baseline_binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)
  
df_baseline_no_theories <- baseline_binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)

```

```{r main trials with (SI) Table. 5}
strict_data_voronoi_freq<- Main_strictInclusion_voronoi_freq_CIs%>%
  select(trial_condition, which_Voronoi_group_text, mean, n)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df <- strict_data_voronoi_freq%>% # provides information in SI Table. 5
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(nSuccess = n*mean,
         pSuccess = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$estimate,3),
         pValue = round(binom.test(nSuccess, n, p=1/5, alternative = "greater")$p.value,3))%>%
  mutate(is_a_theory = case_when(pSuccess>0.2 & pValue < .05 ~ TRUE,
                                 TRUE ~ FALSE),
         trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels = c("2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,aware,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,aware,walkaway",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,pickup",
                                                                        "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,walkaway")))%>%
  select(trial_condition,which_Voronoi_group_text,is_a_theory,pSuccess,pValue,nSuccess,n)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)

trial_condition_no <- binom_df%>%
  group_by(trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(n())%>%
  mutate(trial_no=1:n())%>%
  select(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  ungroup()

binom_df_isTheory <- trial_condition_no%>%
  left_join(binom_df)%>%
  filter(is_a_theory==TRUE)%>%
  select(-is_a_theory)%>%
  arrange(trial_condition)
  
df_no_theories <- binom_df_isTheory%>%
  group_by(trial_no,trial_condition)%>%
  summarise(no_significant_theories=n())%>%
  select(trial_no, trial_condition, no_significant_theories)
```

# Logistic regression on object costs for two-intuition trials
```{r baseline trials}
# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership
baseline_trial2_group1and2 <- data_voronoi_baseline%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="1 agent,accidental")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial2 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial2 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=baseline_trial2_group1and2)
summary(lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2)
```

```{r baseline trial regression results with (SI) Table. 6}
tab_model(lm_baseline_trial2_group1and2,
          title ="glm(which_intuition ~ object_cost, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Object cost"),
          dv.labels = c("the original owner has no intent to relinquish ownership"))
```

```{r main trials}
# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is ignorant and picked up the object
trial3_group2and4 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==2 | which_Voronoi_group==4)%>%
  mutate(`Trial3 G2 & G4` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(2,4)))
lm_trial3_group2and4 <- glm(`Trial3 G2 & G4` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial3_group2and4)
summary(lm_trial3_group2and4)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is knowledgeable and picked up the object
trial1_group2and4 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==2 | which_Voronoi_group==4)%>%
  mutate(`Trial1 G2 & G4` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(2,4)))
lm_trial1_group2and4 <- glm(`Trial1 G2 & G4` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial1_group2and4)
summary(lm_trial1_group2and4)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is ignorant and does not want the object
trial4_group1and2 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial2 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_trial4_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial2 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial4_group1and2)
summary(lm_trial4_group1and2)

# original owner has no intention to relinquish ownership, the second agent is knowledgeable and does not want the object
trial2_group1and2 <- data_voronoi%>%
  filter(trial_condition=="2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway")%>%
  filter(which_Voronoi_group==1 | which_Voronoi_group==2)%>%
  mutate(`Trial4 G1 & G2` = factor(which_Voronoi_group, levels=c(1,2)))
lm_trial2_group1and2 <- glm(`Trial4 G1 & G2` ~object_cost,family=binomial(link='logit'),data=trial2_group1and2)
summary(lm_trial2_group1and2)
```

```{r main trial regression results with (SI) Table. 7}
tab_model(lm_trial3_group2and4, lm_trial1_group2and4, lm_trial4_group1and2, lm_trial2_group1and2, 
          title ="glm(which_intuition ~ object_cost, family=binomial(link='logit'))", 
          show.ci = F, show.stat = T, show.est = T,
          p.style = "numeric_stars",
          string.stat = "Z value", pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Object cost"),
          dv.labels = c("the second agent is ignorant and intends to own",
                        "the second agent is aware and intends to own",
                        "the second agent is ignorant and has no intent to own",
                        "the second agent is aware and has no intent to own"))
```

```{r p-value correction}
# 1agent-accidental, 2agent-ignorant-pickup, 2agent-aware-pickup, 2agent-ignorant-walkaway, 2agent-aware-walkaway, 
p.adjust(c(0.391,0.707,0.168,0.338,0.048), method="bonferroni")   
```

# Figures
```{r Figure 2 - density plot}
# uncomment to save pdf
#pdf(file = "./ITO-exp 1-density plots-v0.pdf", width = 16, height = 13)

# set random seed
set.seed(17) 

# create jitter
Main_conditions_temp<-Main_conditions%>%
mutate(jitter_B=jitter(B,factor=.1),
       jitter_A=jitter(A,factor=.1))%>%
  mutate(trial_condition = factor(trial_condition, levels = c(
  "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,walkaway","2 agents,intentional,aware,walkaway",
  "2 agents,intentional,ignorant,pickup","2 agents,intentional,aware,pickup",
  "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,walkaway","2 agents,accidental,aware,walkaway",
  "2 agents,accidental,ignorant,pickup","2 agents,accidental,aware,pickup"
))) # set trial plot order

Main_conditions_temp%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=jitter_B,y=jitter_A))+
  stat_density_2d(geom = "polygon", contour = T,adjust = 3/7, contour_var = "ndensity",
                  aes(fill = after_stat(level)), colour = alpha("black",0.7),
                  bins = 6) + # 6
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-15,120), breaks = seq(0, 120, by = 50))+ 
  scale_y_continuous(limits=c(-15,120), breaks = seq(0, 120, by = 50))+
  facet_wrap(~trial_condition, ncol = 4)+
  theme_test() +
  theme(# increase thickness for the plot borders
        panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1.5),
        # change how the facet title boxes are presented
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks=element_line(size=1),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(.2, "cm"),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size =20, color="black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size=20, color="black"),
        axis.text = element_text(size=16, color="black"),
        legend.title = element_text(size=16, color="black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size=16, color="black")
        ) +
  xlab("Second agent's ownership")+
  ylab("Original owner's ownership rating")+
  coord_equal()

# uncomment to save pdf
#dev.off() 
```
For the final version of Figure 1 in the manuscript, font type, font sizes, and schematic images were updated using Adobe Illustrator.
